training.title: Training Records
training.description: Employee and management cybersecurity training records. Required by NIS2 Art. 21(2)(g) and BSIG §38(3).
training.helpText: Record all cybersecurity training completions. NIS2 mandates regular awareness training for all employees and specific training for management (BSIG §38(3) - personal liability). Track who completed what training and when.
training.empty: No training records yet. Add your first training record.
training.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this training record?
training.certificateHint: Upload certificate or proof of completion (PDF, image)
training.managementHint: Auto-detected from role. Override if needed.

fieldDescriptions.title: Name of the training course or session (e.g., 'Annual Cybersecurity Awareness', 'Incident Response Workshop').
fieldDescriptions.trainingType: Select the type of training (e.g., awareness, technical, management, incident response).
fieldDescriptions.description: Brief description of the training content, objectives, and target audience.
fieldDescriptions.participantName: Full name of the person who attended or completed this training.
fieldDescriptions.participantRole: Job title or role of the participant within the organization.
fieldDescriptions.isManagement: Enable if this is management-level training. BSIG Section 38(3) requires specific cybersecurity training for management with personal liability.
fieldDescriptions.providerName: Name of the training provider or organization delivering the training.
fieldDescriptions.trainerName: Name of the individual instructor or facilitator.
fieldDescriptions.startedAt: Date when the participant started this training.
fieldDescriptions.completedAt: Date when the participant successfully completed this training.
fieldDescriptions.durationMinutes: Total duration of the training session in minutes.
fieldDescriptions.nextTrainingDue: Date when this participant's next refresher or follow-up training is due.
